statements.text: In file USD01-14/6/2026-ESTT.I, it is suggested that reference to the Finance Department may not be necessary to continue the outsourced Data Entry Operators since the continuation is on the same terms.
statements.quote: Since the continuation is on the same terms, reference to the Finance Department may not be necessary.

statements.text: Under G.O.Ms.No.40, which has a status of not established, no existing engagement shall be extended or continued without the prior concurrence of the Finance Department and the approval of the Government.
statements.quote: Government hereby order that no services shall be contracted or outsourced, and no existing engagement shall be extended or continued, without the prior concurrence of the Finance Department and the approval of the Government.

statements.text: Furthermore, G.O.Rt.No.1184, which is expired, states that any continuation of contract and outsourcing services beyond 31-03-2026 shall require fresh orders of the Government.
statements.quote: Any continuation beyond 31-03-2026 shall require fresh orders of the Government.
